findingDetails.title: Doctor compiled_routes repair binds its new copy-back to hubs the guard reports stale, not to the authored-drift and authored-missing hubs it clears
findingDetails.case: A hub is made authored-drift by the phase's own P9-3 path (reorder tieBreak, run refresh). After the refresh the guard reports the hub under 'Runtime differs from its authored source', not under 'Re-mint'. An operator or agent applying the repair string verbatim reads 'for each hub the guard reports stale, run refresh ..., then copy ... over ...' and finds no stale hub to attach the copy-back to; skipping it leaves the guard red and REQ-003's verbatim-application promise unmet. The same referent gap applies to authored-missing, whose fix the copy-back also provides.
findingDetails.evidence: doctor-update-apply.yaml:160 binds both the refresh and the added copy-back to 'for each hub the guard reports stale'; compiled-route-guard.cjs:170-173 renders stale-manifest under 'Re-mint:' while authored-drift (174-178) and authored-missing (179-183) render under their own headings, so the copy-back's scope contains no drifted or missing hub.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: The guard's per-hub fix lines at :177/:182 independently name the copy, the repair's hook branch copies runtime->authored on commit, and 'stale' may be read loosely as 'flagged'; exact search over the six in-scope files found no test or generator pinning the repair wording.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: 'Stale' may mean any hub the guard flags, and the guard now prints the exact copy line per hub itself, so the end-to-end removal path still names the fix even when the repair text is read strictly.
findingDetails.userImpact: On the P9-3 path a literal application stops after the refresh and the guard stays red; recovery then depends on the operator also reading the guard's per-hub copy line or on the installed hooks copying at commit time.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Exact search over the six in-scope files found exactly one restatement of the repair: this YAML entry; the catalog restatement is the separate open R3-P2-001; no generator or test renders the repair string.
findingDetails.recommendation: Enumerate the classes the repair clears ('stale, drifted or missing'), or bind the copy-back to the guard's per-hub fix line rather than to the stale class.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A repair string whose copy-back is bound to every guard failure class, or a test/generator that reconciles the repair text with the guard's class list, withdraws this finding.
